overview: The Medford City Council approved funding for emergency fire department repairs and community preservation projects while referring major policy discussions regarding ambulance contracts, snowstorm response, and city charter implementation to various committees.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the January 20, 2026, meeting.

items.title: Planning and Permitting Committee Report
items.summary: Referred a proposed vacant building ordinance back to committee for additional public feedback.

items.title: Law Enforcement Identification and Fourth Amendment Rights
items.summary: Referred a resolution requiring officer identification and affirming constitutional search and seizure protections to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee.

items.title: City Charter Implementation Review
items.summary: Referred a resolution to review council-related sections of the new city charter to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Public Hearing: National Grid Pole Installation at 57 Swan Street
items.summary: Continued the hearing to February 24, 2026, because the City Engineer recommended denial based on the availability of existing utility infrastructure and concerns over private use of the public right-of-way.

items.title: License Approvals: Lighthouse Cafe and Placita Mexico Tacos
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license for Placita Mexico Tacos but tabled the request for Lighthouse Cafe to the next meeting as no representative was present.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution to plan city-wide neighborhood ward meetings to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Ambulance Service Contract Oversight
items.summary: Approved combined resolutions requesting full contract documentation, response time data, and a Committee of the Whole meeting with city leadership and the previous and current ambulance providers.

items.title: January 2026 Snowstorm Response Evaluation
items.summary: Referred resolutions requesting a post-storm operational report and a review of street and sidewalk clearing priorities to the Department of Public Works and the Public Works Committee.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund: Engine 5 Heating System
items.summary: Approved a $97,500 appropriation to replace a failed heating system at the Engine 5 station.

items.title: Fiscal 2026 CPA Appropriation Requests
items.summary: Approved the annual Community Preservation Committee recommendations for local project funding.

items.title: Fire Equipment Donation: Leary Firefighters Foundation
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of $19,573 in self-rescue equipment for the fire department.
